465	-- Transcribe a WAV file via the remote OpenAI-compatible API instead of local whisper-cli.
466	-- Returns the hs.task so callers can terminate it on timeout if needed.
467	-- callback(text, detectedLang, errMsg) — errMsg is set (and text empty) on failure.
468	local function transcribeViaAPI(wavPath, lang, timeoutSecs, callback)
469	    local args = {
470	        "-s", "-S", "-f", "-m", tostring(timeoutSecs or 30),
471	        "-F", "file=@" .. wavPath,
472	        "-F", "model=" .. API.MODEL_ID,
473	        "-F", "response_format=verbose_json",
474	        -- Server translates to English if 'language' is omitted entirely (even with
475	        -- task=transcribe) — always send it, "auto" included, to force transcription.
476	        "-F", "language=" .. (lang or "auto"),
477	    }
478	    table.insert(args, API.URL)
479	
480	    local task = hs.task.new(API.CURL_BIN, function(code, out, err)
481	        if code ~= 0 then
482	            local errMsg = curlErrorMessage(code, err)
483	            log("api: curl failed code=" .. tostring(code) .. " err=" .. tostring(err))
484	            callback("", nil, errMsg)
485	            return
486	        end
487	        local ok, decoded = pcall(hs.json.decode, out or "")
488	        if not ok or type(decoded) ~= "table" or not decoded.text then
489	            log("api: unexpected response: " .. tostring(out))
490	            callback("", nil, "unexpected server response")
491	            return
492	        end
493	        callback(decoded.text, normalizeApiLang(decoded.language), nil)
494	    end, args)
495	    task:start()
496	    return task
497	end

538	-- Auto-reload: check mtime and reload if file changed
539	local function loadActionConfig()
540	    local attr = hs.fs.attributes(ACTIONS_FILE)
541	    if not attr then
542	        actionConfig = nil
543	        actionConfigMtime = 0
544	        return nil
545	    end
546	
547	    local mtime = attr.modification or 0
548	    if actionConfig and mtime == actionConfigMtime then
549	        return actionConfig
550	    end
551	
552	    local chunk, err = loadfile(ACTIONS_FILE)
553	    if not chunk then
554	        log("actions: could not load config: " .. tostring(err))
555	        return nil
556	    end

558	    local ok, cfg = pcall(chunk)

580	local function buildActionContext(text, lang, mode)
581	    local ctx = {
582	        text = text,
583	        textLower = text:lower(),
584	        originalText = text,
585	        lang = lang,
586	        outputMode = mode,
587	        appName = capturedAppName,
588	        appBundleID = capturedAppBundleID,
589	        insert = true,
590	        inserted = false,
591	        handled = false,
592	        timestamp = os.time(),
593	        isoTime = os.date("!%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"),
594	    }
595	
596	    function ctx:setText(newText)
597	        if type(newText) ~= "string" then return end
598	        self.text = normalizeText(newText)
599	        self.textLower = self.text:lower()
600	    end
601	
602	    function ctx:disableInsert()
603	        self.insert = false
604	    end
605	
606	    function ctx:enableInsert()
607	        self.insert = true
608	    end
609	
610	    function ctx:launchApp(appName)
611	        if type(appName) ~= "string" or appName == "" then return false end
612	        return hs.application.launchOrFocus(appName)
613	    end
614	
615	    function ctx:appendToFile(path, line)
616	        local resolved = expandPath(path)
617	        if not resolved or resolved == "" then return false, "invalid path" end
618	        if not ensureParentDir(resolved) then return false, "mkdir failed" end
619	        local f = io.open(resolved, "a")
620	        if not f then return false, "open failed" end
621	        f:write(tostring(line or self.text or "") .. "\n")
622	        f:close()
623	        return true
624	    end
625	
626	    function ctx:runShell(command, inputText)
627	        if type(command) ~= "string" or command == "" then
628	            return false, "", "invalid command", 1
629	        end
630	        local token = tostring(os.time()) .. "_" .. tostring(math.random(1000000))
631	        local stdinPath = WHISPER_TMP .. "/action_stdin_" .. token .. ".txt"
632	        writeFile(stdinPath, tostring(inputText or self.text or ""))
633	        local output, ok, kind, rc = hs.execute(command .. " < " .. shellQuote(stdinPath), true)
634	        os.remove(stdinPath)
635	        return ok, output, kind, rc
636	    end
637	
638	    function ctx:keystroke(mods, key)
639	        hs.eventtap.keyStroke(mods or {}, key)
640	    end
641	
642	    function ctx:notify(message)
643	        hs.notify.new({ title = "local-whisper", informativeText = tostring(message) }):send()
644	    end
645	
646	    function ctx:log(message)
647	        log("action: " .. tostring(message))
648	    end
649	
650	    return ctx
651	end

653	local function runActionList(actions, ctx)
654	    if type(actions) ~= "table" then return end
655	    for i, action in ipairs(actions) do
656	        if ctx.handled then break end
657	        if type(action) == "function" then
658	            safeHookCall("actions[" .. i .. "]", action, ctx)
659	        elseif type(action) == "table" and type(action.run) == "function" then
660	            local name = action.name or ("actions[" .. i .. "]")
661	            local shouldRun = true
662	            if type(action.when) == "function" then
663	                local ok, res = pcall(action.when, ctx)
664	                if not ok then
665	                    shouldRun = false
666	                    log("actions: " .. name .. ".when failed: " .. tostring(res))
667	                else
668	                    shouldRun = not not res
669	                end
670	            elseif type(action.pattern) == "string" then
671	                shouldRun = ctx.textLower:match(action.pattern) ~= nil
672	            end
673	            if shouldRun then
674	                safeHookCall(name, action.run, ctx)
675	            end
676	        end
677	    end
678	end

680	local function runPreInsertActions(ctx)
681	    local cfg = loadActionConfig()
682	    if type(cfg) ~= "table" then return end
683	    if type(cfg.beforeInsert) == "function" then
684	        safeHookCall("beforeInsert", cfg.beforeInsert, ctx)
685	    end
686	    if not ctx.handled then
687	        runActionList(cfg.actions, ctx)
688	    end
689	end
690	
691	local function runPostInsertActions(ctx)
692	    local cfg = loadActionConfig()
693	    if type(cfg) ~= "table" then return end
694	    if type(cfg.afterInsert) == "function" then
695	        safeHookCall("afterInsert", cfg.afterInsert, ctx)
696	    end
697	end
